dedupe_keys.name: electricity maps commercial platform of historical real time and forecast grid data electricity mix carbon intensity flows load prices

description: Electricity Maps describes itself as the world's most complete electricity data platform, combining historical data, live grid signals and forecasts for sustainability and power market users. Its pricing page lists signals priced per country per year at hourly granularity, each available as real-time or forecast data: day-ahead wholesale prices (6,000 euros per year), electricity mix by generation source (6,000 euros), cross-border interconnector import and export flows (6,000 euros), total load (4,500 euros) and net load, meaning load minus variable renewable generation (4,500 euros), with a bundle of all grid signals at 18,000 euros per year and custom offers through sales. Coverage: signals are sold per country; the list of countries and zones covered was not read. Format and access: an API and data products sold by subscription, with trials on request; the free data portal could not be read because Cloudflare blocked the cloud. Licence: proprietary (commercial); terms were not read. Caveats: prices were read on 2026-09-29 and may change; the method behind carbon intensity and flow tracing was not read; the open-source parsers the company maintains are recorded in this catalogue. Simulation uses: hourly generation mix, flows and load for grid, cross-border and demand flexibility studies and for carbon accounting of infrastructure operations. Related records: gridstatus (data-gridstatus) is an open library of market data for US operators, and ACER data (data-acer-market-monitoring-datasets-and-dashboards) covers EU markets.
